title: Parse request bodies once, at the edge

concepts.description: TypeScript types vanish at runtime, so data from outside the program must be checked by a runtime schema before it is trusted.
concepts.context: OrderBody.safeParse in orders.ts checks the JSON body before placeOrder sees it

concepts.description: z.infer derives the static type from the schema, so the type and the validation cannot drift apart.
concepts.context: type OrderBody = z.infer<typeof OrderBody> in orders.ts reuses the schema as the type

concepts.description: Validate once where untrusted data enters; code behind that edge can rely on the checked shape.
concepts.context: createOrder in orders.ts rejects a bad body with a 400 before any business logic runs
